pages.title: A Keeper's Account
pages.text: Every proof in this narrow ledger is written twice: once at full price, then once after an earlier construction has simplified its demands.$(br2)The Keepers call the difference a remainder. They do not erase cost; they prove which part no longer needs repeating.

pages.title: Recovered Construction
pages.text: Reading this manuscript records $(thing)The Ledger Of Remainders$() and reveals the $(thing)Axiom Of Parsimony$() and its planning rune.$(br2)Practice with Axiomatic Ink, then compare it with the stable resonance of Nether Quartz. A conserved remainder is an epiphany earned through repeated proofs, not a promise printed on the page.
